slices.label: Adjacency-matrix access · full-output baseline
slices.task: Enumerate every possible edge then compute a proper coloring
assumptions: Pair(u,v) query returns whether the undirected simple edge exists; n known; no neighbor sampling or adjacency list
Explicit full output; deterministic enumeration of n(n−1)/2 pairs, O(m) stored edges

xAxis.label: Palette slack c in q = Δ + c

yAxis.label: Pair query exponent p in Õ(n^p)

parameters.coordinateConvention: The colored bound counts oracle queries alone. The exact output and computation time are separate columns in the table. O(n+m) ≤ O(n²) for a simple n-vertex graph.

results.bound: n(n−1)/2 adjacency-matrix queries + O(m log Δ) randomized computation
results.sourceLocation: STOC 2025 main coloring theorem combined with elementary full matrix enumeration (atlas derivation)
results.notes: The matrix query count is a straightforward construction, not a matrix-oracle theorem of the cited authors. Dense versus sparse graph distinction matters; no lower bound is claimed.
